description: On the green bed sheet in front of you, there’s a pile of colorful beads, a black tape dispenser, and a partly made yellow-and-orange beaded strand with a black cord. The left hand holds the cord steady near the bead pile while the right hand pinches a single bead, moves it toward the cord’s end, threads it onto the cord, and then pulls the cord slightly to tighten and continue the necklace.
